comparison.objective: Slide a booster tray onto both armrests and lock both catches at the second notch.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual large-part alignment against paired sprung ratchets.
comparison.success_condition: Both catches occupy notch two with the tray released and still for one second.
comparison.reason: Paired rail-and-catch seating is not a concentric adjustment-screw/jam-nut countertorque task.
